name: Anurag Mishra
text:
Zabeel Park is truly one of the most beautiful and well-maintained parks in the world. Located in the heart of Dubai, this park offers an amazing combination of nature, technology, and modern attractions. It is a perfect place for families, tourists, and anyone who wants to relax and enjoy a peaceful environment away from the busy city life.

The park is very large and clean, with wide green lawns, beautiful trees, and colorful flowers everywhere. Walking through the park feels refreshing because the environment is calm and full of fresh air. There are many walking tracks, jogging paths, and cycling areas, which makes it a great place for people who enjoy outdoor activities and fitness.

One of the most famous attractions inside the park is the Dubai Frame, which gives visitors a stunning view of both old and new Dubai from the top. This unique landmark makes the park even more special and attracts visitors from all around the world. There are also boating areas, barbecue spots, children's play areas, and many picnic spaces where families can spend quality time together.

Zabeel Park is also known for its modern design and innovative features. It has themed areas, technology displays, and beautifully designed bridges and lakes. Everything is well organized and maintained, which shows the high standard of public places in Dubai.

The park is especially beautiful in the evening when the lights turn on and the weather becomes cooler. Many people come here to walk, relax on the grass, take photos, and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

Overall, Zabeel Park is not just a park, it is a wonderful experience. It perfectly represents the beauty, cleanliness, and modern lifestyle of Dubai. In my opinion, it is one of the best parks in the world and definitely a must-visit place for anyone traveling to Dubai.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
**A Beautiful Oasis in the Heart of Dubai - Zabeel Park**
Zabeel Park is truly a gem in Dubai, offering a perfect blend of green spaces, recreational areas, and stunning views, particularly of the Dubai Frame. My recent visit was an enriching experience, and I can’t wait to share my thoughts!
**Parking:**
Arriving at Zabeel Park was hassle-free thanks to the ample parking spaces available. There are designated parking lots nearby, and it was relatively easy to find a spot, even on a busy weekend. The parking area is well-maintained, and we appreciated the proximity to the park entrance.
**Dubai Frame:**
One of the highlights of our visit was the iconic Dubai Frame, located within the park. We took the opportunity to explore the Frame, which offers breathtaking panoramic views of both old and modern Dubai. The experience was educational as well, showcasing the transformation of the city through various exhibits. It's a must-visit while at the park!
**Playing Areas:**
Zabeel Park has fantastic facilities for families and children. The designated play areas are safe, clean, and filled with fun equipment that kept the kids entertained for hours. From swings to climbing structures, there’s something for all ages. It’s a great spot for families to relax and let the little ones have fun.
**Washrooms:**
The washroom facilities throughout the park were impressively clean and well-maintained. There are several restroom locations, making it convenient to access when needed, especially for families with children. I appreciated that they paid attention to hygiene, which is invaluable in public spaces.
**Amphitheater:**
The park also features a lovely amphitheater that hosts various events and performances. While we didn’t catch a show during our visit, the seating area is spacious and well-designed, making it an excellent place to enjoy live performances in a beautiful outdoor setting. I can only imagine how vibrant it must be during events or festivals!
**Overall Experience:**
Zabeel Park is a well-designed urban oasis that caters to both relaxation and recreation. The lush greenery, various walking paths, and picturesque views provide a tranquil atmosphere, perfect for families, friends, or solo visitors. Whether you’re picnicking, playing, or just strolling around, there’s a little something for everyone.
I highly recommend Zabeel Park to anyone visiting Dubai.  Have a great day here with family !!

name: Shaheer Sp
text:
Dubai Frame is consistently reviewed as a unique and impressive cultural landmark.
The Experience: Visitors are guided through a multi-part experience:
Past Gallery: A multimedia exhibition showcasing Dubai's transformation from a fishing village to a modern metropolis.
Present Dubai (Sky Deck): The main attraction. Visitors enjoy panoramic views from the 150-meter-high sky bridge. Looking one way offers views of "Old Dubai" (Deira, Karama), while the other frames "New Dubai" (Burj Khalifa, skyscrapers), symbolizing the city's past and future.
The Thrill: The most exciting part is the central stretch of transparent glass floor on the Sky Deck, which becomes clear as you step on it, offering a thrilling view 150 meters straight down.
Future Gallery: A final stop that offers a glimpse into the city's ambitious plans for the future.
Value for Money: Many reviewers note that the Dubai Frame is a budget-friendly alternative to the Burj Khalifa's observation deck, offering a great, all-encompassing overview of the city for a much lower cost.
Aesthetics and Architecture: The structure itself, a massive, gold-colored stainless steel frame, is considered spectacular and a striking piece of architecture.
Crowds and Timing: Be prepared for crowds, especially on the glass floor, as everyone wants a photo. Visiting around sunset is often recommended as the best time for views.

Zabeel Park is a popular, expansive green space in the heart of Dubai that is home to the Dubai Frame.
Size and Ambiance: It is one of Dubai's largest parks, described as a lush, tranquil oasis equivalent in size to 45 football fields.
Activities & Attractions: The park is known for its wide range of recreational and entertainment facilities, making it ideal for families:
Family Fun: Features extensive children's play areas, obstacle courses, and designated picnic and barbecue spots.
Sports & Fitness: Includes jogging tracks, a pedestrian path, a fitness center, and facilities for mini-golf, skating, and a BMX track.
Seasonal Events: It hosts seasonal attractions like the Dubai Garden Glow and the Dubai Flea Market (in cooler months).
Other Features: There are beautiful fountains, water features, a boating lake, an amphitheater, and even an internal train to help navigate the large grounds.

name: K. Gurung
text:
My visit to Zabeel Park left me with a largely positive impression. The sheer size of the park—spanning about 47.5 hectares, equivalent to 45 football fields—offered plenty of space to explore, making it feel like a true urban oasis amidst Dubai’s bustling cityscape. The lush greenery, with over 3,000 palm trees and 7,000 other trees, provided a refreshing escape, and the views of the iconic Dubai Frame were a highlight, adding a modern architectural flair to the natural setting. I enjoyed the variety of activities available, from the jogging track to the picnic areas, which made it clear why it’s a popular spot for families and fitness enthusiasts alike. The pedestrian bridges connecting the park’s sectors were a thoughtful touch, ensuring easy navigation despite Sheikh Zayed Road cutting through it.

That said, it wasn’t perfect. The entry fee of AED 5 is reasonable, but I noticed some attractions like the Dubai Frame and Dubai Garden Glow require separate tickets (AED 50 for adults for the Frame, for instance), which could add up if you’re planning a full day out. I also found that some areas felt underutilized—certain facilities, like the domed attraction I’d read about, were closed during my visit, which was a bit disappointing. Accessibility could be improved too; getting there via the Al Jafiliya Metro station was convenient, but walking to the park’s main gates felt a little cumbersome, especially in the heat. Overall, it’s a fantastic spot for a relaxed day out, though it could benefit from better upkeep of all its features and clearer signage for first-timers like me.

text:
If you're visiting Dubai and looking for a great spot to unwind, Zabeel Park is one of the best places to go. Situated in the heart of the city, it’s not only expansive but also strategically located close to major landmarks. This means you get to enjoy green space while being surrounded by the city's iconic architecture. One of the standout features of Zabeel Park is its proximity to the famous Dubai Frame, an architectural wonder that frames views of both the old and new parts of Dubai.

Getting into Zabeel Park is very affordable — you only need to pay 5 Dirhams for entry. If you're driving, parking is also available for just 10 Dirhams, which is a pretty decent price for such a centrally located park. However, if you're planning to visit the Dubai Frame, make sure to head to Gate 4, as this entrance is specifically for the frame. For general access to the park, it's recommended to enter through Gate 1, 2, or 3.

Zabeel Park isn't just about open lawns and peaceful green spaces. It’s an excellent venue for family gatherings, especially since it has a dedicated kids' playground to keep the little ones entertained. There’s also a special area for BBQs, where you can rent spaces and grill up your favorite food while enjoying the outdoors. If you feel like exploring more of the park without tiring yourself out, you can even rent a scooter to cruise around the park at your own pace. It’s a fun and convenient way to see everything the park has to offer!

The park also hosts various events throughout the year, including some large-scale celebrations like the New Year’s Eve festivities. If you're lucky enough to visit during these special occasions, you might just catch a grand fireworks show or live entertainment. The vibe here is always lively, but it’s also spacious enough to find a quiet spot if you're just looking to relax.

Overall, Zabeel Park is one of those places in Dubai where you can have it all — a perfect mix of relaxation, family fun, and even a bit of adventure. Whether you’re here to explore, attend an event, or just spend quality time with family, the park’s location, amenities, and affordable entrance fees make it a must-visit in Dubai.

text: Opened in 2005, the park covers an area of ​​52 hectares and includes a large number of trees, green spaces and areas designated for children to play! It is located in the middle of various commercial areas, the most important of which are Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Karama area, and it is adjacent to the World Trade Center in the heart of Dubai. It includes many facilities and services, including: a cricket field (by prior reservation), basketball, football and tennis courts, a park theater, models of sister cities, restaurants and cafes, a boat lake, a bicycle rental service, a suspension bridge that passes over one of the main streets outside the park, children's play areas, boat rental, barbecue and trip areas, a sports track, fitness equipment and free parking for park visitors.

text:
5point Review
UAE is a desert country, but you have to drive away from the cities to actually see the desert. Amidst the never-ending puzzle of zigzagging roads and towering skyscrapers, you can find some beautiful (and mostly huge) public parks, constructed by Dubai Parks Authorities. A big thumbs up to the Government for first conceptualizing and developing these parks and then maintaining them in these harsh climates in an immaculate manner. Now here are my 5-Pointers on some of the best Dubai parks. Dubai might not have a Central Park like New York, but there are many alternatives in different areas for some fun-filled picnics. (These parks might not be big enough attractions for tourists, but they are sure shot life savers for the residents)
1. Zabeel Park
Activity Duration: A couple of hours of lazy strolls or a half-day picnic with a barbecue. The choice is yours.
Ratings: 7/10 (Tourists can club this park with their tour of Dubai frame)
1. The Good: Huge area (we only explored one part of it and didn't go to the other side of the road). Magnificent views of the frame. Lush green grassy banks. Many play areas and lots of spaces to make your barbecues. Perfect place for a family outing.
2. Thumbs down: Whatever that domed attraction was closed. Not situated on a beach so no water fun.
3. The WoW Factor: Great picture opportunities with the magnificent Dubai Frame. All different angles can be assessed from here.
4. Money matters 5 aed per pax. It's totally worth it.
5. The 5-Point Experience: A great place for family picnics and gatherings You can barbecue or order food and have it here. The place is huge so doesn't feel crowded even on weekends.
My Verdict: Try out this park on a leisurely family weekend.

text:
beel Park in Dubai is a true urban gem, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and cultural vibrancy. My recent visit to this stunning park was made even more special by the fact that I was there to attend the renowned *Jashan-e-Rekhta* literature festival, a celebration of Urdu language, poetry, and literature. The festival transformed the park into a cultural haven, where poets, writers, and literature enthusiasts gathered to share their love for words, stories, and the rich heritage of Urdu.

One of the highlights of my visit was the unforgettable concert by the legendary Shafqat Amanat Ali. His soulful voice, combined with the enchanting ambiance of Zabeel Park under the starry Dubai sky, created a magical experience. The way he effortlessly blended classical and contemporary music left the audience in awe. It was a night filled with emotion, melody, and pure artistry—a true celebration of music and culture.

Zabeel Park itself is a delight, with its expansive green spaces, beautifully landscaped gardens, and modern facilities. The park offers something for everyone, whether you’re looking to relax, take a stroll, or enjoy recreational activities. The atmosphere during the festival was electric, with food stalls, book exhibitions, and engaging discussions adding to the vibrant vibe.

Overall, my experience at Zabeel Park, especially during the *Jashan-e-Rekhta* festival and Shafqat Amanat Ali’s concert, was nothing short of extraordinary. It’s a place where nature, art, and community come together, creating memories that will last a lifetime. If you’re in Dubai and have the chance to visit Zabeel Park, especially during such events, don’t miss it—it’s an experience that will leave you inspired and rejuvenated!

name: Bavoos
text:
Not only is Zabeel Park one of the largest parks in Dubai, but it’s also one of the first technology-driven green spaces in the Gulf.

Equivalent in size to 45 football fields, this tranquil spot is located in the centre of the city and is popular for a children’s amusement complex and expansive ‘edutainment’ centre.

Zabeel Park is home to the city's newest attraction, the Dubai Frame, from where visitors can take in incredible views of both old and new Dubai.

Explore three different zones to find a vast array of activities for yourself and your family: the Alternative Energy Zone, Communications Zone and the Techno Zone. They are all technology-based, featuring educational and interactive exhibits.

The park also offers live music, barbecue and picnic areas, restaurants and boat rides. It also hosts large exhibits like the Dubai Garden Glow during the cooler months. But, there are plenty of all-year-round facilities to enjoy, like the mega-bowl, galleries and sculptures.

You’ll also find sports options, aside from a pedestrian path, jogging track and fitness centre. Take your pick from mini-golf, cricket, skating, skateboarding and the BMX track.

name: Varun Albert Joshua
text:
Zabeel Park (Arabic: حديقة زعبيل) is an urban public park located in the Zabeel district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is bounded by Sheikh Rashid Road to the north, the Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road to the northwest, while the Sheikh Zayed Road cuts through the south. The park is divided into numerous sectors connected by pedestrian bridges, and there are multiple entrance gates.
The Dubai Frame is located inside the park.

Situated between Al Karama and the Dubai World Trade Centre, Zabeel Park covers much of the Al Kifaf area. It is accessible from the Red Line of Dubai Metro via the nearby Al Jafiliya Station.It is maintained by the Public Parks and Horticulture Department of Dubai Municipality.
The park was opened to the public in December 2005, in an inauguration ceremony by Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid Al Maktoum.The size of Zabeel Park is 47.5 ha (117.375 acres), or about 45 football fields.
The parking capacity can accommodate 2,300 vehicles.

text:
The park is one of the city's largest and most frequented, and is a popular spot for sports and live music  Entry fee is 5 AED. it houses the famous DUBAI FRAME. The biggest frame in the World. It contains various recreational facilities including a 2.5 km jogging track on the park perimeter, pedestrian tracks, BMX track, skateboarding park, barbecue and picnic areas, a boating lake, lakeside restaurants, ice skating, a mini cricket pitch and golfing area, shaded seating and children's play areas. There is also an exhibition gallery, prayer rooms, a fitness centre, and various monuments.The park has a technology-based theme, with three zones (the Alternative Energy Zone, Communications Zone and the Techno Zone) containing educational and interactive displays. It also offers a 3D cinema for edutainment activities.

There are over 3,000 palm tree plantations in the park, in addition to 7,000 other trees of a variety of 14 species.Visitors have access to Wi-Fi internet.

name: Prashanth Kumar
text:
Zabeel Park is truly one of Dubai’s most beautiful and well maintained parks. It is a perfect blend of nature, relaxation, and family friendly park. The greenery, wide walking tracks, and stunning views of the city skyline make it an ideal spot for morning walks, picnics, or just unwinding after a busy day.

The park is huge, with plenty of shaded areas, clean facilities, and lots of open space for kids to play. The Dubai Frame located within the park adds a unique charm and offers a fantastic photo opportunity. The lake area, boating options, and the dedicated cycling and jogging tracks are great additions for fitness lovers and families alike.

Weekends here are vibrant with picnics, food stalls, and small gatherings, yet it never feels overcrowded thanks to its vast area. The cleanliness and maintenance are top notch, and the staff are always courteous and helpful.

Whether you are looking for a peaceful morning walk, a fun evening with kids, or just some quiet time surrounded by greenery. Zabeel Park is one of the best places to visit in Dubai. A must-visit for both residents and tourists...

name: Mohamed Karuvattil
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Dubai Frame in Zabeel Park—an architectural wonder that defines Dubai’s skyline in a breathtaking fashion.

Stepping into this monumental structure felt like entering a gateway to Dubai’s past, present, and future. The view from the top deck is a mesmerizing blend of the city’s historic charm on one side and the modern skyline on the other, creating a juxtaposition that’s simply awe-inspiring.

The highlight? Walking on the glass bridge—a thrilling experience for those seeking an adrenaline rush and an unforgettable view. The panoramic vistas from the top are nothing short of spectacular, offering a bird’s eye perspective of the city’s evolution.

Pro tip: Pre-book your tickets to avoid waiting in long lines, especially during peak times. Trust me, the view from the top makes it worth every effort.

The interactive exhibits inside add depth to the experience, providing fascinating insights into Dubai’s past and its futuristic vision.

The Dubai Frame in Zabeel Park is not just a frame; it’s a window into the grandeur and innovation that define this remarkable city. A must-visit for anyone looking to capture Dubai’s essence in one spectacular sight!

Zabeel Park is a hidden gem nestled in the vibrant heart of the city, offering a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of urban life. As a frequent visitor, I find this park to be a delightful haven for relaxation, recreation, and rejuvenation.
Whether you're a resident or a tourist, Zabeel Park is a must-visit destination for those seeking a blend of nature, recreation, and cultural experiences. It stands as a testament to Dubai's commitment to creating spaces that harmoniously integrate modernity with nature. I highly recommend a visit to Zabeel Park for a refreshing and enjoyable day out.
One of the park's standout features is the iconic Dubai Frame, which stands tall at one end, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline. The architecture is a marvel in itself, seamlessly blending modernity with traditional design elements.

name: Sapna M
text:
Modernized masterpiece, Dubai, UAE, Zabeel Park dubai Stargate, Park, Entertainment, children’s play areas

Zabeel Park Dubai rises from one end of Karama and extends to the more private Zabeel area. Being one of the largest parks build in Dubai,  Zabeel takes a high ranking in its popularity between Dubai residents.

The large park separated by the main road which links to the Shaikh Zayed road offers a range of activities to its visitors including the large children’s entertainment facility STARGATE located in the heart of the park.

The layout of the park can be classified as a modernized masterpiece with its adventure playground dedicated strictly to the children of all ages cascading into the large amphitheater area where many special attractions take place. With large areas dedicated to grass and scenic beauty, families are attracted to have special get-togethers as the specialized covered areas furnished particularly for outdoor barbeques.

Some other attractions of Zabeel Park include the themed miniature children’s play areas available all around the park, the variety of technological and architectural models layered throughout and the man-made lake where you can take a personal boat ride for a small amount.

Finally, Zabeel Park with its extensive appeal and charm will definitely allow you the satisfaction of a great outdoor experience without leaving the city limits.

Working hours:

8 AM to 10 PM ( Till 11 PM on Thursday, Friday, Saturday and public holidays)
Entry fees:

5 Dhs Per Person
Free Entry for people with special needs &  kids below 2 years
You can use NOL card for entry

How to go to Zabeel park by metro:

Al Jafiliya metro station is the nearest metro station. Al Jafiliya metro station is located on Red Line of the Dubai Metro.

name: sheeba
text:
Professional Review of the Iftar Venue

I recently visited this venue for an iftar experience, but it did not meet my expectations. Upon arrival, I had to pay an entry fee of 5 AED. While the venue had a few dress stalls, a coffee stand, and some seating arrangements, the overall ambiance felt underwhelming.

For dining, I opted for a burger meal, which cost me approximately 51 AED. In general, meal prices ranged from 35 AED to 65 AED. However, I was disappointed by the lack of traditional desi iftar options such as pakoras or dahi bhalay, which are usually a staple during Ramadan. The available food choices seemed limited for those looking for an authentic iftar experience.

Additionally, the shopping options for Ramadan or Eid attire were not particularly appealing, with limited variety and selection. While the market setup had potential, it did not offer a compelling shopping or dining experience.

That being said, I did enjoy the outdoor seating area, which provided a pleasant atmosphere to relax and enjoy the weather. However, considering the overall experience, I believe the venue could improve its offerings, especially in terms of food variety and retail options, to better cater to visitors seeking a complete Ramadan experience.

name: Kapish Joshi
text:
The Dubai Frame is a truly magnificent structure that will leave you absolutely awestruck. As I entered the city of Dubai from the airport, it was the first massive thing that caught my eye, and I was immediately captivated by its grandeur.

At first glance, the Dubai Frame gives the illusion of having a massive mirror in between its frame, but it's truly remarkable how this illusion is created without any actual mirrors. The golden frame gleams and reflects the opulence and sophistication of the city, making it an iconic landmark.

While you have the option to enter the park surrounding the Dubai Frame, I chose to admire it from the outside, as I was primarily interested in capturing a picture of this architectural marvel. The view is stunning even from outside the park, and it's a must-see sight for anyone visiting Dubai.

If you're eager to ascend to the top of the frame and enjoy a panoramic view of the city's skyline, there is an entrance fee for the park. It's a worthwhile experience for those who want to take in the breathtaking vistas that Dubai has to offer. Whether you decide to enter the park or not, the Dubai Frame is a spectacular attraction that truly lives up to its reputation, and it's an iconic symbol of this vibrant city.

text:
Zabeel Park is honestly one of my favorite spots in Dubai. It’s huge, super clean, and perfect if you just want to chill out, walk around, or spend time with family. The greenery is amazing and makes you forget you’re in the middle of the city. Kids have plenty of play areas, there are tracks for jogging and cycling, and even boating if you want something fun to do.

The best part for me is the view of Dubai Frame from inside the park—it looks beautiful, especially around sunset. Entry fee is very cheap for what you get, parking is easy, and there are food stalls if you feel like grabbing a snack. On weekends it can get a bit busy, but because the park is so big, you still find your own space.

If you’re living in Dubai or just visiting, this is definitely a place you shouldn’t miss. It’s perfect for families, friends, or even just some quiet time alone.

name: BritonJohnny
text:
Zabeel Park is one of those rare places in the city where you show up stressed… & leave wondering why families like us never thougth to come here everytime. The moment we stepped inside, it felt like nature itself was saying, “Relax. I got you.”

Our 3-year-old, after being trapped in our tiny 1BHK all day everyday, went full superhero mode the second he saw the massive green spaces & the play areas. Swings, slides, climbing frames — you name it, they've it. And the best part? He found new friends within minutes! Suddenly, it was like he’d joined an exclusive toddler squad. All kids were running around, jumping, laughing, & just enjoying being kids — with zero drama. We parents silently celebrated this precious break in peace!

The park is huge, super clean, & beautifully maintained. Some families were out with their picnics & BBQ grills, cooking up feasts that smelled so good we almost joined a random family’s dinner. The vibe is incredibly chilled — enough space for everyone to sit, stroll, snooze, socialize, or watch kids burn their battery to 0%.

Now here’s something that truly impressed me — the park is almost circular in shape, & we noticed tons of people walking & jogging around it like disciplined fitness warriors. They park their cars in the giant parking area, step out, & just start burning calories like it’s nothing. Meanwhile, I’m here burning absolutely nothing except energy thinking about how they’re burning energy. Respect to them! One day, maybe even I’ll join the movement… but for now, I’ll cheer them on from the comfort of a bench. 😄

Zabeel Park is the perfect escape when the walls of home feel too close & the toddler energy level feels too high. If you want a calm, green, happiness-packed outing where your kid gets entertained for free (and you get some sanity back), this place is an absolute must-go.

We’ll definitely be returning — mainly because our little one already has new buddies waiting for round two!

name: Hemanti Devrukhkar
text:
Zabeel Area, Near Al Jafiliya Metro Station - Dubai. Year 2005, Zabeel Park is one of the major public parks in Dubai, thanks to its distinct location and unique features and elements.

The Zabeel Park entry fee is AED 5 per person. However, the park offers free entry for differently-abled individuals and children below 2 years of age.

JOGGING IN WIDE-OPEN LUSH-GREEN WALKWAYS
THE DINOSAUR PARK
DUBAI GARDEN GLOW
THE DUBAI FRAME
TOURIST TRAIN AND BICYCLES
Zabeel Park boat ride tickets: AED 40 for a two person small boat, and AED 50 for a large boat with seating capacity for four. Each boat gives a 20 minutes ride.

ZABEEL PARK CRICKET GROUND
Cricket buffs will be delighted to know that there is a giant cricket pitch in Zabeel Park Dubai. Considering what things to do in Zabeel Park, how about having a game of cricket on the weekend? Gather your friends after a busy work week and have a game of cricket during the day before families flock to the park with little kids.

ZABEEL PARK FLEA MARKET
The Zabeel Park Flea Market is a highly anticipated event among the local community of Al Karama and other adjoining areas. The event is counted among the popular things to do in Zabeel Park. The Flea Market attracts a large influx of visitors looking for bargain deals on second-hand products. Considered as the biggest flea market event in Dubai, the market is an excellent option to get something you need at a very low price. Coming early to the flea market is recommended to avoid any parking inconveniences.

Venues for Sports
Apart from the tranquil walkways, kids play area and other attractions, there are various sporting venues. The mini-golf course, skating, skateboarding arena and the BMX track to name a few are a good way to get some physical exercise among other things to do in Zabeel Park Dubai.

Dubai has a plethora of parks but Zabeel Park stands out from the rest for a variety of reasons. Spread over an area equivalent to the size of 45 football fields, this serene spot is one of the first technology-driven green spaces in the UAE. It’s also one of the largest public parks in Dubai with different attractions. No matter what your tastes are there are many different things to do in Zabeel Park.

From pop up shops to barbecue pits and dance parties, there’s no shortage of attractions at this park. The various activities at Zabeel Park in Dubai make it a popular venue to visit during weekends.

name: Sid Sid
text:
A Perfect Family Day Out at Zabeel Park, Dubai! 🌳🌞
Zabeel Park is truly one of Dubai’s hidden gems for families! From the moment we entered, we were greeted with lush greenery, wide open spaces, and a peaceful atmosphere that felt like a breath of fresh air in the heart of the city.
The park is incredibly well-maintained, with clean walkways, shaded picnic areas, and plenty of benches to relax. The kids absolutely loved the dedicated play zones, especially the interactive educational exhibits and the dinosaur park — a big hit with little explorers!
One of the highlights was the Dubai Frame, which offers stunning panoramic views of both old and new Dubai. It’s a must-visit and adds a unique cultural and architectural touch to the park experience.
There are also plenty of food stalls and cafes around, making it easy to grab a snack or enjoy a picnic. The boating lake and train rides added an extra layer of fun for the whole family.
Whether you're looking for a peaceful stroll, a fun-filled day with the kids, or a scenic spot for a weekend picnic, Zabeel Park ticks all the boxes. Highly recommended for families and nature lovers alike!

name: Ramin Yousefi Pour
text:
Concern Regarding Staff Behavior at Zabeel Park

Dear Zabeel Park Management,

On Friday, 14th December, my family and I visited Zabeel Park. As closing time approached, announcements were made for visitors to begin clearing the park. We immediately started packing our belongings and preparing to leave.

However, within just 10 minutes, staff members approached us four times in a club car, despite clearly seeing that we were already packing. Their repeated approach was accompanied by rude and discourteous behavior, which caused distress to our children and family.

We fully understand the need to clear the park promptly at closing time, but the manner in which visitors are addressed should always be respectful and professional. Public parks are meant to be welcoming spaces, and staff interactions play a big role in ensuring that.

I kindly request that management provide proper training to staff on how to approach visitors courteously, especially during closing procedures. This will help maintain the park’s reputation as a family-friendly environment and ensure that all guests feel respected.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

name: Alain Portmann
text: A green oasis the size of 45 football fields, located in the middle of Dubai. The park features over 3,000 palm trees, in addition to 7,000 other trees of a variety of 14 species. There is a mandatory 5 AED entry fee to the park that does include access the Dubai Frame. There is strict policies in place including no outside food, no ball games and no dogs allowed. The park is divided into numerous sectors connected by pedestrian bridges, and there are multiple entrance gates. The Dubai Frame is located in the park but there is many recreational facilities including a 2.5 km jogging track on the park perimeter, pedestrian tracks, skateboarding park, barbecue and picnic areas. The parks three technology zones (the Alternative Energy Zone, Communications Zone and the Techno Zone) where closed down or under refurbishment. If not driving take the red metro and get off at Max Metro Station and walk 15-minutes to the park.

name: Capt VO
text:
Great entertainment place for the family. The magic place is a superb place for trick photography with numerous illusions available. The Dino Park and the Glo Garden are spread over a huge area with a number of displays to view.  Personally, I felt the charges were slightly on the higher side. If you plan to visit, then keep at least 3 hours for the visit to have a complete experience.
My family and I were at the counter at around 9.15 pm and the lady at the counter coerced us into buying tickets for all three experiences; i.e. Magic Park, Dino Park & Glo Garden, assuring us that we could complete all three within the closing time of 10.30pm, as I checked twice with her if we would be able to go through it completely.
Unfortunately, by the time we finished the Magic Park, which we did in a rush, it was 10.10 pm, which left us with only around 20 mins to finish the other two parks, which we could not and therefore could not enjoy in fulness the value we had paid.
Take a trip with your family 👪, the children will love the experience! ⛲🏞🦖🐲🦕📷🤳

name: Aby Tom
text:
Zabeel Park is an urban public park located in the Zabeel district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is bounded by Sheikh Rashid Roadto the north, the Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road to the northwest, while the Sheikh Zayed Road cuts through the south.The park is divided into numerous sectors connected by pedestrian bridges, and there are multiple entrance gates
Situated between Al Karama and the Dubai World Trade Centre, Zabeel Park covers much of the Al Kifafarea. It is accessible from the Red Line of Dubai Metro via the nearby Al Jaffliya Station. It is maintained by the Public Parks and Horticulture Department of Dubai Municipality

name: Divine Spear
text:
As far I remember Zabeel Park is largest park in Dubai and very clean. Very good park cleaning individuals. If you are coming from Metro come out from Landside.

Entry Fees: 5 AED, only allowed to pay using NOL card. You can buy the card at the counter itself.

Huge parking lots around the parks on each gates that makes it easy to get inside park nearby. Cafeterias all over parks. There are some areas designated for grilling (BBQ), use only those places or you will be fined.

For Kids:
Rental Bike rides, playgrounds, Dinosaur parks and other activities.

Attractions:
Lots of greenery places and nice space to gather with friends and family to enjoy.
Beautiful view of Dubai frame (Near Park C) recently opened for public, evening the Dubai frame is lighted as different color which very pleasant to watch.
Every Friday they have an open market (Flee market).
A long jogging/running track is there.
Lightings of Glow Garden.
BBQ facilities.

Zabeel Park Review – A Refined Retreat in the Heart of Dubai

Zabeel Park is a verdant sanctuary amidst Dubai’s urban splendour, offering a harmonious blend of nature, design, and serenity. Elegantly landscaped with manicured gardens, tranquil lakes, and tree-lined promenades, it provides a graceful setting for leisurely walks and quiet reflection. The park’s refined charm is elevated by contemporary art features and the majestic Dubai Frame rising at its heart. Impeccably maintained and thoughtfully designed, Zabeel Park stands as a sophisticated testament to the city's vision of green elegance within a modern metropolis.

One of the highlights is the Dubai Frame, which offers stunning views of the city and is just a short walk from the park. The park itself features beautiful landscapes, plenty of shaded areas, and even some lovely lakes, making it a perfect spot for a morning jog or a relaxing afternoon.

The park is clean and safe, with plenty of seating areas and facilities like cafes and restrooms. Whether you’re enjoying a peaceful stroll, spending time with family, or having a picnic, Zabeel Park provides a nice mix of nature and city life.

Highly recommend visiting if you're looking for a lovely green space in the city to unwind and enjoy the outdoors!

name: Ecstatic
text:
Zabeel Park is one of the largest and most popular parks in Dubai, located in the Zabeel area near the Dubai Frame. Covering around 47.5 hectares, it is a green oasis in the city, offering a variety of recreational activities, gardens, and attractions.

Key Features of Zabeel Park
•	Dubai Frame – One of Dubai’s iconic landmarks, the Dubai Frame stands within Zabeel Park, offering panoramic views of old and new Dubai.
•	Technology & Edutainment – The park features interactive exhibits, including a technology-based learning center.
•	Lush Gardens & Picnic Areas – It has beautifully landscaped gardens, picnic spots, and BBQ areas.
•	Jogging & Cycling Tracks – There are dedicated paths for jogging and cycling.
•	Children’s Play Areas – Equipped with swings, slides, and other play equipment.
•	Boating & Lake Activities – Visitors can enjoy pedal boats and other water activities.
•	Events & Festivals – The park hosts seasonal events, outdoor markets, and entertainment shows.
•	Fitness Zones – Open-air gyms and exercise stations are available.

Timings & Entry Fee
•	Timings: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Extended hours on weekends and public holidays)
•	Entry Fee: AED 5 per person (Dubai Frame has a separate ticket price)

How to Reach
•	Metro: The nearest metro station is Al Jafiliya (Red Line).
•	Bus & Taxi: Easily accessible by public transport and taxis.

name: Idrees Tajik
text:
**Zabeel Park: A Serene Oasis in the Heart of Dubai**

Nestled in the bustling metropolis of Dubai, Zabeel Park (حديقة زعبيل) is a true gem that offers a perfect escape from the city's fast-paced life. This sprawling green haven is a harmonious blend of nature, technology, and leisure, making it a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists.

As you step into the park, you're greeted by lush landscapes, manicured gardens, and a sense of tranquility that instantly soothes the soul. The park's design is a testament to Dubai's commitment to sustainability and innovation, featuring solar-powered pathways, eco-friendly facilities, and a stunning view of the iconic Dubai Frame.

One of the highlights of Zabeel Park is its diverse range of activities. Whether you're looking to enjoy a peaceful stroll, have a family picnic, or engage in sports, the park has something for everyone. The jogging tracks are perfect for fitness enthusiasts, while the children's play areas are a delight for young ones. The park also boasts a serene lake where you can rent paddle boats and enjoy the gentle breeze.

For tech enthusiasts, Zabeel Park is home to the Dubai Garden Glow, a mesmerizing attraction that combines art, technology, and sustainability. The illuminated installations and themed zones are a visual treat, especially in the evening when the park transforms into a magical wonderland.

The park's cleanliness and well-maintained facilities are commendable, reflecting the city's dedication to providing a world-class experience. The staff is friendly and always ready to assist, ensuring that your visit is comfortable and enjoyable.

Zabeel Park is more than just a park; it's a place where nature and modernity coexist harmoniously. Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or simply a moment of peace, this park offers it all. A visit to Zabeel Park is not just a day out—it's an experience that leaves you refreshed, inspired, and connected to the beauty of Dubai.

name: Narjis Batool
text:
📍 Located in: Zabeel Area, Dubai
🚇 Nearest Metro Station: Max Metro Station (Red Line)
🚗 Parking: Available inside and outside the park

The park is well-connected, making it easy to access by metro, taxi, or car.

Entry Fee

🎟️ Entry Ticket: 5 AED per person
💳 Payment (cash/nol card/card)

Attractions & Activities

🌿 Green Spaces & Walking Tracks

The park is beautifully maintained with vast green lawns, palm trees, and shaded areas. It has long jogging and cycling tracks, making it perfect for morning walks, runs, or bike rides.

🎡 Dubai Frame

One of the biggest highlights of Zabeel Park is Dubai Frame, a massive architectural landmark offering breathtaking views of old and new Dubai. Entry to the frame is separate from the park’s entrance fee.

🏃‍♂️ Fitness & Sports Facilities
•	Dedicated jogging & cycling tracks
•	Outdoor gym & fitness stations
•	Cricket pitch and football field
•	Basketball and tennis courts

🎭 Amphitheater & Events

Zabeel Park hosts live events, concerts, and markets, especially during the cooler months. The park is home to the popular Ripe Market on weekends, where you can find organic produce, handmade crafts, and food stalls.

🚤 Boating & Water Activities

You can enjoy boat rides in the small lake inside the park. Paddle boats and other rental options are available.

🎮 Technology & Edutainment Zones

Zabeel Park is one of the first technology-driven parks in Dubai, featuring interactive displays, a 3D cinema, and an edutainment center for children.

⸻

Food & Dining Options

🍽️ There are several cafés and food kiosks inside the park, but choices are limited. Many people prefer to bring their own food and enjoy a picnic. Barbecue stations are also available in designated areas.

⸻

Best Time to Visit

☀️ Winter Season (October – March): Perfect for outdoor activities
🌙 Evenings & Weekends: Livelier atmosphere with more visitors
🔥 Summer (June – September): Best to visit in the late evening due to the heat

⸻

Pros & Cons

✅ Pros:
✔️ Affordable entry fee (only 5 AED)
✔️ Beautiful green landscapes and walking trails
✔️ Family-friendly with kids’ play areas
✔️ Variety of activities, including boating, sports, and events
✔️ Close to Dubai Frame

❌ Cons:
✖️ Can get very crowded on weekends
✖️ Limited food options inside the park

name: Isham Azad
text:
I recently visited Zabeel Park to collect my bib for the Dubai Run, and while the experience was overall smooth, there was one minor disappointment. The process of picking up the bib was efficient, with clear signage and staff who were helpful and friendly. However, when I went to collect the t-shirt along with the bib, I found out that it wasn’t available at the time. While this was a bit frustrating, the staff assured me it would be available later.

Despite the t-shirt issue, Zabeel Park itself was a lovely location for the bib collection, with its open green spaces and vibrant atmosphere. The park has excellent facilities, and it was great to be part of such an exciting event in a beautiful setting. I'm looking forward to participating in the Dubai Run, and I'm hopeful that the t-shirt will be available soon! Overall, the experience was positive, though a bit more communication regarding the t-shirt distribution would have been appreciated.
